owner_goal: Elastic independent Elephant self-organization and test-led gap closure from frozen baseline to updated MVP v0.5; SDK and Elephant system dogfood first

streams.name: self-model-and-self-organization
streams.hypothesis: Elephant introspection and role allocation can be empirically grounded
streams.first_falsifier: withheld context or unavailable telemetry must not be reported as known

streams.name: command-wiki-semantic-sdk
streams.hypothesis: One source-pinned SDK command can explain its own real tool
streams.first_falsifier: Wiki claim inconsistent with underlying source or tool witness

streams.name: automated-experimental-learning
streams.hypothesis: Reusable tooling shortens independently verified correction cycle
streams.first_falsifier: end-to-end wall time/regressions worse than existing baseline

streams.name: human-machine-spatial-parity
streams.hypothesis: Custom visual language preserves canonical meaning and safe actions
streams.first_falsifier: visual re-theme hides consequence or alters semantic command digest

streams.name: context-handoff-communication
streams.hypothesis: Verifiable handoff is reconstructable by an independent Elephant

streams.name: mvp-feasibility-wildcard
streams.hypothesis: Smallest demonstrated useful MVP path can be independently justified
streams.first_falsifier: claimed progress depends on simulated/live evidence confusion
